name: @tompassarelli/agent-machinery
description: Provider-independent agent doctrine, types, templates, and procedures

scripts.build: bun run build:ownership && bun run build:selection && bun run build:agents
scripts.check:ownership: beagle check scripts/work-ownership.bjs && beagle fmt --check scripts/work-ownership.bjs && bun scripts/check-work-ownership-generated.mjs
scripts.check:selection: beagle check scripts/selection-statistics.bjs && beagle fmt --check scripts/selection-statistics.bjs && bun scripts/check-selection-statistics-generated.mjs
scripts.check: bun run check:ownership && bun run check:selection && bun scripts/validate.mjs
